developers.title: Developers
developers.intro: Internal notes for people working on the Hub Énergie integration or this documentation site. Nothing here is required to install or use Hub Énergie in Home Assistant.
developers.flow_preview_body: Built from config_flow.py and strings.json — same labels and branching as the real wizard. The preview is not Home Assistant: no entity validation or network calls.
developers.flow_catalog_body: After changing the flow: run python scripts/extract_config_flow_catalog.py and commit site/src/data/flowCatalog.generated.json. CI fails if that file is stale.
